Based on the screenshot of the Vietnamese recycling marketplace "GreenCity" Discover page:

**Verification Results:**

1.  **Search Bar:** ✅ **Visible.** Located at the top center with placeholder text "Tìm ve chai, đồ cũ, khu vực..." (Search for recyclables, used items, location...).
2.  **Category Chips Row:** ✅ **Visible.** A horizontal scrollable row of pill-shaped buttons is present below the search bar, including categories like "Tất cả danh mục" (All categories), "Giấy & Bìa carton", "Nhựa tái chế", etc.
3.  **Product Cards Grid:** ✅ **Visible.** The main content area displays a responsive grid (4 columns wide) containing product cards. Each card features an image, status badge ("Còn hàng"), title, price in VND, location, and time posted.
4.  **Broken Layout:** ❌ **No broken layout detected.** The sidebar navigation, header elements, search area, category filters, and product grid are all properly aligned and rendered without overlapping or visual glitches.

**Summary:** The UI is fully functional and well-structured, displaying 11 products as indicated by the count label.
